chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from some of his companions, from al-Washshāʾ, from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Mukhtār, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The deceased is not to be shrouded in black.

key_terms.السَّوَادِ: black cloth or the color black in the context of shrouding

ai.seo_question: Can a deceased Muslim be shrouded in black cloth?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the shrouding of the deceased. It indicates that the dead should not be given a kafan in black cloth, reflecting prescribed funerary etiquette in fiqh.
